tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Single keyless JSON array with no documented query, page or limit parameters: `query`, `category`, `min_budget`, `page` and `limit` are not sent and the whole feed (a few hundred rows) is returned; filter client-side. Element 0 of the feed is the legal notice (id null) and is dropped by the runtime (`require: [id]`). Fields per the feed: slug, id, epoch, date, company, company_logo, position, tags[], description (HTML), location, apply_url, salary_min, salary_max, url; currency is not stated. Attribution: link back (follow) to the Remote OK URL and name Remote OK as the source.
